title: Luffu's New Health and Safety Wearable Isn't Just for You. It's for Your Entire Family - CNET
summary: Launched by Fitbit co-founders James Park and Eric Friedman in February, Luffu started out as an app where family members could log health information, including medications, diet, doctors’ appointments, vaccine records, symptoms and more.
